A [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] '''outpost''' was set up on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The outpost was single-handedly destroyed by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Kavos]], massacring all of its personnel.
